id: 23_Chemical Spills & Exposures Mastering Laboratory Safety Emergency Protocols Trai
title: 化学品溢洒与接触的应急处置

points.K7: 空气被污染时用呼吸器

points.K15: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，身后有溢洒处理箱，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a spill kit box behind, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，具体讲讲化学品溢洒。
overlay: 化学品溢洒与接触的应急处置

shots.scene: 小研戴口罩在显微镜前，旁边台面上试管打翻，红色液体流开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a mask works at a microscope; beside her, tubes and a syringe tip over and red liquid spreads on the bench.
shots.narration: 实验室里，最常碰到的就是溢洒。

shots.scene: 地面积液特写，戴黑手套的手用蓝布擦台面
shots.prompt_en: A close view of liquid pooled on the floor, and a hand in a black glove wiping the bench with a blue cloth.
shots.narration: 溢洒比我们愿意承认的更常见，

shots.scene: 小洒漏图标扩散成大片
shots.prompt_en: A small spill icon spreading into a large puddle with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 但同样危险，处理对才不会酿成大祸。

shots.scene: 穿蓝色工作服的老李在走廊拖地
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in blue overalls mops a corridor floor.
shots.narration: 清理方法，因物质和情况而异。

shots.scene: 酸、溶剂、粉末三种溢洒图标，各配不同工具
shots.prompt_en: Three spill icons: an acid puddle, a solvent puddle and a powder pile, each paired with a different cleanup tool icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不是所有溢洒都能一样处理。

shots.scene: 货架上的化学品桶，阿杰大声喊，周围人转头
shots.prompt_en: Beside a shelf of chemical drums, the young male student calls out loudly and nearby people turn to look.
shots.narration: 溢洒了怎么办？先让大家都知道。

shots.scene: 说话气泡图标向四周扩散
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble icon with sound waves spreading outward. No people.
shots.narration: 大声说出来，告诉周围的人。

shots.scene: 老周快步走过，空走廊，空实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks quickly away down a corridor, leaving an empty corridor and an empty lab.
shots.narration: 不需要在场的人，都请出去。

shots.scene: 吸附条围住溢洒，挡住流向
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent socks are placed in a ring around the spill, blocking it from spreading. No people.
shots.narration: 然后是围堵：隔离溢洒，不让它扩散，

shots.scene: 盾牌罩住几个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon covering a group of person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 免得危及更多人。

shots.scene: 贴红色标签的透明溢洒处理箱，小研取下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes down a clear spill kit box with a blank red label.
shots.narration: 经过授权，就拿溢洒包来处理。

shots.section_title: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
shots.scene: 穿防护服戴全面罩的王老师在显微镜旁
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator in a protective suit and full-face respirator stands beside a microscope.
shots.narration: 实验一乱，呼吸器就是关键。
overlay: 空气被污染时用呼吸器

shots.section_title: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
shots.scene: 瓶子倾倒绿色液体泼溅，空中漂浮颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A bottle tips over and green liquid splashes, with fine particles floating in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品飘进空气，或感染性物洒出，

shots.section_title: 空气被污染时用呼吸器
shots.scene: 戴防毒面具的人举起烧瓶，白烟冒出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a gas mask holds up a flask as white fumes rise.
shots.narration: 这时就要靠呼吸器。

shots.scene: 带滤毒盒的半面罩贴合面部
shots.prompt_en: A half-face respirator with chemical cartridges fitting snugly on a face icon. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品：要贴合，配对滤毒元件挡烟气。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴防颗粒口罩和护目镜，病原颗粒被挡住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a particulate respirator mask and goggles, with airborne germ icons blocked.
shots.narration: 生物危害：选能挡住空气病原的。

shots.scene: 王老师给小研做适合性测试
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator performs a respirator fit test on the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 员工用呼吸器前，必须做适合性测试，

shots.scene: 小研戴半面罩举起烧瓶，绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a half-face respirator holds up a flask, a green check beside her.
shots.narration: 确保防护到位，空气变险时就靠它。

shots.scene: 粉色生物溢洒桶和黄色化学溢洒桶
shots.prompt_en: A pink biohazard spill kit bucket and a yellow chemical spill kit bucket side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒包是真正的救命包，

shots.scene: 溢洒包物品平铺：中和剂、吸附垫、手套、护目镜
shots.prompt_en: Spill kit contents laid flat: neutralizer containers with blank labels, absorbent pads, gloves, goggles and a full-face mask. No people.
shots.narration: 中和剂、吸附垫、手套、护目镜，样样齐。

shots.scene: 台面上散落的瓶子和纸巾，中和剂撒在酸液上
shots.prompt_en: Scattered bottles and paper towels on a bench, with neutralizer being sprinkled onto an acid spill. No people.
shots.narration: 酸或碱洒了，先加中和剂。

shots.scene: 戴黄手套的手用吸附垫擦台面角落
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a yellow glove soaks up the residue in a bench corner with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 控制住以后，用吸附垫吸干净。

shots.scene: 堆着的垃圾袋，戴手套擦台面
shots.prompt_en: A pile of red waste bags, and a gloved hand wiping the bench clean.
shots.narration: 所有废物，都按实验室规程处置。

shots.scene: 扎紧的黑色垃圾袋
shots.prompt_en: A tied black waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 清理不只是让溢洒消失，而是处理得当。

shots.section_title: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲够15分钟
shots.scene: 红色急救包，液体溅到手臂和眼睛的图标
shots.prompt_en: A red first aid kit, and icons of liquid splashing onto a forearm and toward an eye. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品沾到皮肤或眼睛，别犹豫，
overlay: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲够15分钟

shots.section_title: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲够15分钟
shots.scene: 安全淋浴和洗眼器标志，阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower sign and an eyewash sign; the young male student rinses his eyes at the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 马上去安全淋浴或洗眼器，

shots.section_title: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲够15分钟
shots.scene: 流水不停，计时器图标显示15分钟
shots.prompt_en: Water keeps flowing with a blank stopwatch icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 彻底冲洗至少15分钟。

shots.section_title: 溅到皮肤眼睛：冲够15分钟
shots.scene: 阿杰冲得不耐烦想走，小研按住他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks impatient under the water; the female graduate student gently keeps him there.
shots.narration: 会觉得很漫长，但千万别缩短。

shots.scene: 戴蓝手套的手给手臂缠绷带，医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a blue glove wraps a bandage around an arm, beside a hospital icon.
shots.narration: 冲完之后，立即就医。

shots.scene: 小研陪阿杰走向医院
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to a clinic building with a red cross sign.
shots.narration: 化学暴露不能等，马上检查。

shots.section_title: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
shots.scene: 王老师拿记录板，空白规范手册封面有星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a clipboard beside a blank guideline book with a stars-and-stripes flag icon.
shots.narration: 美国职业安全卫生管理局有明确指南。
overlay: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急

shots.section_title: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
shots.scene: 说明书、标签、储存柜、应急图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a blank safety data sheet, a blank bottle label with a pictogram, a chemical storage cabinet and a siren. No people.
shots.narration: 熟悉说明书，标签贴对，正确储存，

shots.section_title: 懂说明书、标签、储存和应急
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰拿平板查看应急流程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student review an emergency flowchart on a tablet.
shots.narration: 清楚出事怎么做，照着体系做。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现告知、清场、围堵图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a speech bubble, an exit arrow and a barrier ring.
shots.narration: 告知、清场、围堵，授权再处理。

shots.scene: 呼吸器、中和剂、吸附垫图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a respirator, a neutralizer container and absorbent pads. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器先测试，酸碱先中和再吸附。

shots.scene: 淋浴、洗眼器、15分钟、红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a safety shower, an eyewash station, a stopwatch and a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到冲足15分钟，然后就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a clean lab bench with a spill kit on the wall.
shots.narration: 临危不乱，按步处置，下次见！
